newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Consumer Portfolio started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Consumer Portfolio started.

text.p: -- Montgomery Securities said its analyst Jordan Hymowitz started coverage of Consumer Portfolio Services with a buy rating.
-- Hymowitz expects the company to earn $0.87 a share in fiscal 1996, ending December, and $1.05 in fiscal 1997. His six month price target on the stock is $16.
-- In a statement, Hymowitz said the company has shown strong loan growth without a deterioration in credit quality, and is one of the best loss-reserved lenders in the automobile finance industry.
